items.summary: Huge congratulations Shreyas @shrez_royal09 - youngest ever British chess champion at just 17! Happy to have played a small part in supporting your journey to the top. Congratulations to the amazing Bodhana too! English Chess Federation (ECF) (@ecfchess) 🏆 The 2026 British Chess Championships are complete! ♔ British Champion: Shreyas Royal ♕ British Women's Champion: Bodhana Sivanandan, who claimed the title after a dramatic rapid play-off against Trisha Kanyamarala. Congratulations to all of this year's champions ! ❤️♟️ — https://nitter.net/ecfchess/status/2086501136278630618#m
